Per-case and per-behavior parity matrix for all 25 cases, 75 v1 observations, and 23 behaviors

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Both ADL subjects are pinned by exact source revision and executable SHA-256, and the v2 identity also binds selector generation, lock digest, and current-main ancestry
AC-2: The exact merged #5337 corpus bundle and all retained v1 evidence envelopes, portable stream hashes, repetitions, required fragments, and normalization derivations verify before comparison
AC-3: Every one of 25 cases, 23 behaviors, two equivalence groups, and one difference group has a deterministic v1/v2 result at the same accepted revision
AC-4: Normalization is limited to reviewed #5337 rules and cannot discard exits, arrays, diagnostics, identities, signature verdicts, sequential order, or a real semantic difference
AC-5: Every case has exactly one of exact_match, normalized_match, approved_intentional_difference, regression_blocker, unsupported_blocker, or evidence_invalid, with zero unknown or deferred rows
AC-6: Every approved intentional difference links a reviewed owner decision, rationale, replacement proof, risk, reviewer, and rollback impact; all other mismatches block

AC-7: Runtime v3 overlay binds exact terminal evidence for all ten proof groups from #5591/#5592/#5589/#5590/#5341/#5349 and grants no credit to fixture-, metadata-, library-, fixed-bootstrap-, degraded-, or Runtime-v2-reuse proof
AC-8: WP-10A overlay binds terminal #5497 convergence and live #5501 proof without inferring behavior from issue closure alone
AC-9: Required comparison, overlay, budget, strict-lint, dependency, test-count, deterministic rerun, no-network, and exact-review lanes all pass with no acceptance deferral

AC-10: WP-11 changes no product, Runtime v2, selector, default, cutover, deletion, AWS, credential, or publication state during preparation, and future completion authorizes only the #5361 acceptance input
